Initial public release of CodexMeter, a macOS menu bar app for keeping Codex usage visible at a glance.

## Highlights

- Added menu bar display for 5 hour and weekly Codex usage limits.
- Added menu view with reset times, remaining credits, refresh controls, and shortcuts to Codex and the usage dashboard.
- Added local preference storage for polling interval, status bar display mode, and notification threshold.
- Added notification support for low usage limits.
- Added Codex auth discovery from `~/.codex/auth.json`.
- Added app icon, screenshot, README, security notes, contributing notes, and GitHub Actions release automation.
- Added tests covering usage formatting, state handling, preferences, notifications, auth, and service behavior.
